elana: Heads up  Customer Delta private pilot: asks = reserved prewarm, HSM/KMS key, canary w/auto-fallback to hosted, and 99.9% latency SLO. Need owners + blockers + runway.

sam: Runtime volunteer  I'll do prewarm orchestration, batching tuning, KV cache sizing. What's peak QPS/tokens?

elana: Rough: 160-220 qps bursts, ~18-22k tokens/min. Cold p99 target <150ms.

tess: Platform can template the rollout, but we need security signoff for KMS access before enabling private control plane.

ravi: Security: KMS/HSM needs vendor attest + threat-model review. Estimate 7-12 business days after we get SOW + key policy. IAM role defs required.

juan: Infra: can hold 2x A100 for May window; T4s cheaper but worse p99. Need final commit date to convert to reserved capacity.

sam: Prefers A100. If T4, we'll need aggressive quant and expect ~25% higher p99.

elana: Model = 7B SFT fp16; KV cache ~3GB/shard x4. I'll share spec and traffic numbers by Wed.
